GTE-73 The Dreadnaught

North Katy is officially hosting GTE-73 on November 6-8, 2026. The Growth Training Exercise (GTE) is the premier leadership development weekend from Freedom Ops and F3 Nation. This event transitions leadership theory into practical application through physical and mental friction. North Katy hosting a GTE is very special to me, being a Freedom Ops Cadre, so I am looking forward to going Under the Log with my brothers from across the regions in the Greater Houston/Katy area. 

Early Bird pricing starts today and is in effect for the next 30 days. Secure your spot now to lock in the lowest rate.

When:
Friday-Sunday November 6-8, 2026

Leadership Team:
• Host Q: @Klondike 
• Co-Host Q: Seagal
• Support Q: @Fajita 
• Host Region Nantan: @Excel (North Katy) 

Details and registration: https://event.freedom-ops.fit/gte-73/details

WEEKEND COMPONENTS & TIMELINE
Exact locations and precise times will be provided closer to the event date.

The Rally (Friday 1800)
The initial fellowship gathering. This phase allows the PAX to meet the Freedom Ops team, align on expectations, and address final gear or operational questions.

The King Builder (Saturday 0600)
A FREE convergence-style beatdown open to ALL men. The King Builder combines a BD with core leadership lessons led by Freedom Ops! This is a (multi-) regional convergence event and an excellent opportunity to invite FNGs.

GrowSchool (Saturday 0900-1200)
A classroom leadership seminar focused on the QSource manual. This phase features interactive breakout sessions to analyze and implement virtuous leadership within families, workplaces, and communities.

The Culminating Ruck Event
The main effort of the GTE. This endurance ruck phase immediately tests the leadership principles taught during GrowSchool under conditions of stress and exhaustion. Head knowledge to heart knowledge. 

THE THREE RUCK PATHS
Participants select one of three endurance tracks for the culminating leadership exercise.

The Impact Ruck - 5 hours
A scaled version of the Crucible, covering 5-10 miles. The Impact Ruck delivers the same focus on teamwork and physical adversity as the Crucible but on a shortened timeline without the full overnight commitment. This is great forpax new to F3 (<3 months), pax with little to no sandbag and ruck experience, pax with time constraints (cannot commit to the overnight), and pax with physical limitations. 

The Crucible Ruck - 15 hours
The premier overnight GTE event. This track covers 15 to 20 miles cumulatively. It is a rigorous team endurance challenge designed to stretch physical thresholds and build cohesion through heavy carries and  evolutions of team building exercises. This event is for pax experienced in sandbag and ruck workouts and pax who have been in F3 for greater than 3 months posting consistently. 

The Respect Ruck - 24 hours
An endurance ruck covering 20-25 miles and adapted for PAX looking to level up and push themselves further than before. This path maintains high leadership and physical standards. This option is reserved for those who have completed a GTE previously (GRE is not applicable) and for pax that have been in F3 for at least 12 months posting consistently. 

PREPARATION AND REGIONAL COOPERATION
To prepare for this event, North Katy will host monthly GTE-preparedness rucks. Be on the lookout for preblast from Klondike!

Other surrounding regions are also stepping up by hosting training events and localized training plan initiatives.

We are actively pushing for multi-regional cooperation and attendance. To get your region bought in, consider hosting "lunch and learns" featuring testimonials from past GTE participants.

If you have questions, want to coordinate training, or would like me to come down to your region for a lunch and learn guest Q, reach out directly. I am available to visit and talk to your PAX about what to expect at GTE.

VOLUNTEERS NEEDED
The support team is absolutely crucial for the success of GTE-73. An event of this scale cannot happen without dedicated men on the ground managing logistics, safety, and hydration. If you cannot participate in the physical tracks but still want to make a high impact on the region, we need you on the support crew. Reach out to Fajita (Support Q) to volunteer.

NEXT STEPS
1. Register: Use the link below to secure Early Bird pricing before it expires in 30 days.
2. Train: Attend the monthly preparedness rucks and begin conditioning with weighted rucks.
3. EH Your Brothers: Share this announcement and ensure your AO is represented.

A message to the newer guys—- Don’t be concerned at all if you struggle with some (or maybe all) of the exercises on any given day. You’re doing better than you think. When you’re new, your body is learning a whole new language, and that takes time. Don’t compare your Day 1 to someone else’s Year 1. 

Also, the Qs often look more fit and capable than they actually are. Look to the Q as a model for the exercise, not as a fitness barometer. There are two reasons PAX will look and do better when they are Qing. 

1) Qs tend to choose exercises they’re good at. They have plenty of weaknesses, you’re just not as likely to see those on their Q days. When Qing, I know I’m being watched so I’m not going to select a bunch of exercises I don’t like and cannot model good form doing. 

2) There is a thing called leadership energy or performance adrenaline — it’s a boost you get when you’re the one setting the pace, guiding others, or being watched. 

So, always feel free to modify down. Know you’re getting a little better each day. And what truly matters is that you showed up and you’re trying, and that’s already a win. 
Oh and your future self says thanks you!

The time is upon us once again. That hour before sunrise when men from every corner of F3 life gather in the gloom for one purpose... brotherhood, fellowship, growth, and the sharpening of men. This year marks 4 YEARS since a flag was planted at The Spillway on July 9th, 2022.
What started with courageous HIMs stepping away from The Station to confront the Sad Clown Syndrome in our own neighborhoods became something far greater than anyone imagined. On launch day, over 120 men from across multiple regions showed up to witness the birth of The Spillway.

Since then, countless men have passed through the gloom, but the spirit of this AO continues to grow stronger with every beatdown, every conversation, and every challenge conquered together, and the impact spread far beyond one flag.

From Katy to MKT to North Katy, new leaders emerged, new AOs launched, and the mission expanded. The Beacon lit the way, followed by the birth of The Edge, The Juggernaut, and eventually our night AO, The Eclipse. What began as one planted flag became a movement.

Join us Saturday, July 11th, 2026, as we celebrate:
🔥 The Spillway 4-Year Anniversary
🔥 F3 North Katy Region 1-Year Anniversary

We’ll celebrate the victories, reflect on the failures that made us stronger, and look ahead to the continued acceleration of men across our communities.

This is more than a workout. More than a flag. This is The Spillway. 👊
